decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate heat exchangers for HVAC are close to the core offer and benefit from rising demand for efficient building climate control and heat pumps.
The marine cooling unit still fits the firm's marine lifecycle offering, though the earlier withdrawal of the box cooler line suggests the marine segment is under review.
The compact oil cooler line builds on established competence and serves recurring industrial and transportation demand, so withdrawal is unlikely.
Finned tubes are a core component for the firm's own air coolers and also sell externally, which makes them strategically important.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes draw on the firm's R&D strength and support its efficiency and sustainability promise amid rising energy costs.
